executive_summary: Min Woo Lee offers compelling upside at +1732 coming off his 2025 victory here with excellent +0.122 course fit and 5.5% model win probability. The longshot tier is loaded with value, particularly Ben Griffin at +5571 who carries +1.01 SG Total with 17.3% top-10 probability, making him an outstanding tournament play.

insights.title: Lee's Defending Champion Value
insights.insight: Min Woo Lee won this event in 2025 and shows strong +0.122 course fit with +1.62 SG Total ranking #2 in the field. At +1732 odds, the model sees 5.4% edge over implied probability.

insights.title: Gerard's Ball-Striking Surge
insights.insight: Ryan Gerard ranks #2 in the field in approach play (+0.80 SG) and #3 overall in SG Total (+1.27), yet sits at +4522 odds. His T9 finish here in 2025 adds course confidence.

insights.title: Double-Threat Putting Advantage
insights.insight: Jake Knapp (+3368), Sam Burns (+4573) both rank top-4 in SG Putting with +0.60 each. Putting typically separates winners at Memorial Park.

insights.title: Griffin's Longshot Profile Shines
insights.insight: Ben Griffin at +5571 carries solid +1.01 SG Total with an impressive 17.3% top-10 probability. His complete game profile makes him the week's best longshot tournament play.

insights.title: Kitayama's Consistent Course Record
insights.insight: Kurt Kitayama ranks #4 in approach play (+0.69 SG) with solid course history (T39 in 2025, T36 in 2024). At +3819 odds, he offers 2.5% model edge with proven Memorial Park form.

insights.title: English Offers Elite Longshot Value
insights.insight: Harris English at +6022 provides +1.08 SG Total ranking #9 in the field with 16.3% top-10 probability. His ball-striking ability makes him severely underpriced in this range.

insights.title: Hughes Maximum Course Advantage
insights.insight: Mackenzie Hughes shows the field's best course history adjustment at +0.102 strokes, indicating strong Memorial Park fit. At +13757 odds, his course knowledge creates longshot appeal.
